name: New River Valley Governor's School for the Arts and Humanities
org: Radford University, New River Community College and regional school divisions
what_you_do: Take arts and humanities classes at Radford University for three hours each weekday morning, earn up to 30 college credits, and do internships and mentorships with regional arts groups.
who_can_apply: Selected students from nine public high schools in the partner divisions: Radford City, Giles, Floyd, Pulaski and Montgomery County public schools.
pay_detail: Page says students earn nearly two years of college credit at no cost to the family.
duration: Three hours each weekday morning during the school year
deadline_text: Application dates not posted on the page read. Ask your school counselor.
how_to_apply: Tell your counselor or gifted resource teacher, tell your parents, line up two teacher recommenders, get your transcript, then fill out the NRVGSAH Application Packet.
notes: School districts arrange transportation to Radford. Choose from visual arts, dance, theatre, music, design, history, politics and philosophy. The program is new.
